content.text:
I fixed it, but haven't checked it in the browser yet. During a round, a green dot now shows a ✓ and a red dot shows an ✗, the same as the example on the mission briefing.

**What was wrong:** the example dots on the briefing had the ✓ and ✗ typed straight into the page. The code that draws the dots during a round (`renderDots` in `public/app.js`) only coloured them in and never added the mark. Those dots were also smaller (14px, or 12px on phones), too small to hold a mark.

**What I changed:**
- **`public/app.js`:** the round dots now get a ✓ or ✗ when you answer.
- **`public/style.css`:**
  - The dots are 20px everywhere, so the mark fits.
  - On phones they shrink a little to 18px. There are only 5, so they still fit across the screen.
  - The example dots on the briefing now use the same style as the round dots, so the two will stay alike.

Screen readers still read the summary on the row of dots ("Round 3 of 5, 2 correct"), so the marks are hidden from them to avoid reading the same thing twice.

I haven't committed. Want me to commit and push to `New_Features`?
